title: Syn-STARTS: Synthesized START Triage Scenario Generation Framework for Scalable LLM Evaluation

prompt.location: Appendix A, Figure 10 ("Models were provided with a patient's narrative description and prompted to output the corresponding START triage tag")

claim.location: Appendix E, Table 2(a), row GPT-4, Datasets(A) column
